data.headline: KJFK: typical arrival delay Fri 01:00 local — median 5 min, 80% within -20…85

claims.text: Over 44 Fri 01:00 hours in the BTS record (Jun 2025–May 2026), median arrival delay at KJFK was 5 min and 80% of hours fell within -20…85 min (~2 arrivals/h). Climatology, not a forecast.

citations.quote: BTS On-Time Performance for KJFK, 44 Fri 01:00 hours from Jun 2025 to May 2026: median arrival delay 5 min; 80% of hours fell within -20 to 85 min (10th to 90th percentile); about 2 arrivals per hour. This is climatology — historical typical values — not a forecast.
